# Damped oscillator Lagrangians

Claims about variational formulations of dissipative systems.

claims.name: dampedOscillator_caldirolaKanai
claims.statement: The Caldirola–Kanai Lagrangian $L = e^{\gamma t}(\tfrac12 m\dot x^2 - \tfrac12 k x^2)$ reproduces the damped equation of motion.

sources.title: Two Lagrangian formulations of the damped harmonic oscillator

claims.name: dampedOscillator_krylovComplexity
claims.statement: Krylov complexity exhibits dissipative features for the damped harmonic oscillator.
